peak_pose: standing beside an invisible window edge, one elbow resting high on the invisible ledge at shoulder height, hip popped out to the side, chest turned three-quarters toward the viewer and pushed forward, free hand on her hip
expression: lazy, confident smirk and slow-blinking bedroom eyes
motion: She leans her weight into the invisible ledge, slowly sliding her hip out and rolling her chest toward the viewer; a soft, natural bounce follows the lean; her free hand slides down to her hip, a slow wink, then she eases back to the start pose. The ledge itself is never drawn.
name: window_perch_lean
